The distant kingdom of [[Thalassara]] is a secluded realm recently thrust into the spotlight by the fall of a fragment of the moon. What began as a rush for the newly discovered moonsilver has quickly turned into something far more troubling.

body.legend:
A dark, unholy union between orcs and vampires, giving rise to a terrifying hybrid race known as the Norcferatu.
The legend follows a tragic perversion of ancient traditions, deeply tied to the lore of Vengoth.The Rise of the NorcferatuHistorically, the orcs of this region possessed a proud, ancestral warrior culture guided by shamanistic traditions.
However, vampiric corruption seeped into their clans. Vampiric leaders, culminating in the father of vampires Vladrukh, warped the orcs' lineage to create orc-dhampir hybrids. This unholy combination fused the raw, physical brutality of orcs with the dark, life-draining blood magic of vampires.The Perverted RitesThe legend is carried heavily by two specific cultist factions of the Norcferatu that players uncover during the quest:The Nightweavers: These were once noble orc shamans and spiritual leaders. They completely abandoned the light to fuse their shamanistic heritage with shadow worship and blood magic, turning their ancestral visions into waking nightmares.The Heartless: In a display of extreme, twisted devotion, these orc-dhampirs literally carve out their own hearts with crude blades. They believe that removing their hearts severs all emotional weakness and fear of death. They preserve their beating hearts in iron-bound "Heart Amphorae" hidden in unholy shrines, fighting as completely unstoppable, emotionless fanatics
The Wrath of the AncestorsThe core tragedy of the story is the absolute defilement of the orcs' heritage. When players commune with the Orcish Ancestor Spirits during the quest, the spirits express deep rage and sorrow. They lament that while their bones rested in the crimson soil, they had to watch their descendants corrupt their own bloodlines and let their noble legacy fade into monstrous servitude.
To aid the player in stopping Vladrukh, the ancestors require a ritual called the Ritual Dance of the Red Moon—a traditional dance meant to awaken the "fire in the blood" and restore a temporary echo of the old, uncorrupted ways to bypass the fortress defenses.Would you like to know more about Vladrukh's specific background as the Father of Vampires, or perhaps the role that Anaztassja Moroia plays in trying to stop them?

body.history:
In {{OfficialNewsArchive|2304|2013}}, an additional mission became available to successful game worlds. Players who complete it may talk to [[Brutus The Baker]] and receive a {{Ilink|Cake Cabinet Kit|Cake Cabinet}} [[Cake Cabinet Kit]].

In {{OfficialNewsArchive|2683|2014}}, two additional rewards for Brutus' mission were added — the {{Ilink|Cake Backpack}} [[Cake Backpack]] and the {{Ilink|Cake Tapestry}} [[Cake Tapestry]]. However, a player can only chose one of the three rewards.

In {{OfficialNewsArchive|4485|2018}}, a group of three more rewards were added: a {{Ilink|Blueberry Cupcake}} [[Blueberry Cupcake]], a {{Ilink|Strawberry Cupcake}} [[Strawberry Cupcake]] and a {{Ilink|Lemon Cupcake}} [[Lemon Cupcake]]. Again, each player can only choose one of the three cupcakes. Additionally the experience bonus changed from being '''5% for five days''' to being '''50% for seven days''' for premium players only.
body.legend: Defeat the invading cake golems and use the corpses of your conquered enemies to build a bridge to a legendary island reachable only once a year. There you will have to face a challenge unlike any before. Grab your fork and be ready.
body.location: [[Carlin]], [[Thais]], [[Edron]], [[Darashia]] or [[Liberty Bay]] during the first stage. [[Cake Keep Isle]] south of [[Cormaya]] on the second stage.
body.name: A Piece of Cake
body.reward: Successful worlds get seven days of 25% more health and mana regeneration and an experience bonus of 50% for premium players. Achievements [[Cake Conqueror]] and [[I Did My Part]]. One reward item: a [[Cake Backpack]], a [[Cake Cabinet Kit]], or a [[Cake Tapestry]]. One of three Cupcakes: [[Blueberry Cupcake]], [[Strawberry Cupcake]] or [[Lemon Cupcake]].

body.history:
[[File:The_Winterlight_Solstice.jpg|thumb|right|500px]] Can you feel the frozen wind coming from the sea? Do you feel the coldness spreading across the land?</br></br>

Those sudden weather shifts are foretokens of the [[Percht Queen]]'s awakening! Her frozen kingdom is a stronghold of neverending winter! Shielded by [[Percht|perchts]] and [[Schiach|schiachs]], she holds sway over the snow-clad island with an iron fist. 

It is said that no gear or cloth can withstand the withering cold that comes from her halls. Even the most daring warriors who sought to breach her throne room iced over on their way and were shattered into a thousand bits by her ruthless thralls. 

As of server save on December 22, a boat, that ferries over to the frozen realm will be at anchor near Svargrond's harbour. Once you have set foot on the island, you should talk to [[Frosty]]. The friendly snowman will tell you more about the icy place and its shaggy inhabitants.

At the end of the event (server save on January 10), all game worlds will receive a whole week of increased respawn rates (x2) while mana & health points regenerate twice as fast.

Conquer the Percht Queen's frozen realm!
body.legend: The Percht Queen is awakening. Are you brave enough to resist the perishing cold that originates from her chambers and stop it from creating a neverending winter?
body.name: Winterlight Solstice

On {{OfficialNewsArchive|7987|August 05, 2024}} this event has been revised and the following changes were introduced:
* After Devovorga's incarnations have been defeated for a second time, her cocoon will spawn after a 5 minute delay, giving all players the opportunity to join the boss fight.
* Devovorga will have a higher initial resilience to ensure the fight lasts longer than before.
* For some incarnations, HP and XP have been increased.
* Furthermore, the level ranges have been adjusted as follows:
** [[Anmothra]] level --> no changes
** [[Irahsae]] level 40-60 --> 40-80
** [[Teneshpar]] level 40-80 --> 40-160
** [[Chikhaton]] level 70+ --> 160+
** [[Phrodomo]] level 70+ --> 160+
* In addition to the increased health and mana regeneration by 50% as world reward, the XP for extra dimensional monsters will be increased by 15% for the month of September.
* The [[Vengoth]] [[Dread Guardian]] now offers a new animated item in exchange for 55 [[Tentacle Piece]]s: The [[Bursa Obscura]], a single-slot container for the backpack slot with a weight of just 1.50oz.

body.history:
This quest has been slowly implemented in the course of several updates. Hence, even though it was initially released with [[Updates/10.10|The First Part of the Summer Update 2013]], different parts of it were released over the course of many years. The last known content related to it was released in [[Updates/12.31.9667|April 2020]]. During the [[Test Server]] for the [[Summer Update 2021]], CipSoft Content Team member and creator of this quest, [[Lionet]], said the following:

:''The arc around the Planestrider is already complete, everything necessary for this has already been implemented. However, the Planestrider and Planegazers both affected the world in several ways and their history matters of course. Players are bound to discover things related to their legacy here and there, now and then. Remember that the Planestrider has shown a form and was shaped by things, but it may just as well be one of many different interpretations of the concept.''
